letters.Miss Me:
Hi sayang,

If I could fold the distance between us, I'd be beside you right now. Until then, let this letter be a hug that stays a little longer.

Love, Zen ♡
letters.Hard Day:
My Qish,

You don't need to be sunshine every day. Take your time, rest when you need to, and be gentle with yourself.

Love, Zen ♡

The stars are on night duty now, love. Whatever today was like, you made it through. Sweet dreams, Qish.

Love, Zen ♡

Love, Zen ♡
